column1: # One row per file in upstream lily/ (LilyPond 2.27.2, the pinned reference), so the
# remaining engine work is COMPUTED rather than remembered. EPG0 built it; every later
# EPG session updates the rows it lands.
#   3 detail        ported  -> the C# file(s) carrying it, ';'-separated, repo-relative
#                   group   -> the EPG group that owes it
#                   no-port -> why it has no analogue in the port
#   4 notes         free text; blank for the ordinary cases

# A 'ported' row means the file's TYPE and ALGORITHMS are carried. It does NOT assert
